traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Needle Sword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite’s next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.text: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one crea- ture within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target’s emotions and alignment.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requir- ing no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
